name: ...And the Men that Come to See Me
Text: Can only be played when the card titled For the Women that Want to Be Me... is in your Ring area. Reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. If your opponent is a Male Superstar, he discards # cards, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: ...Change Reality
Text: Can only be played when the cards titled Wake Up... and ...Look Around... are in your Ring area. As an action, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards. Then, search your opponent's Arsenal for up to 3 cards, put them into his Ringside pile, and he shuffles his Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: ...Look Around...
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Wake Up... is in your Ring area. As an action, look at your opponent's Backlash deck and choose 1 Action card. Your opponent discards the card chosen. As a reversal, reverse any Action card played from your opponent's hand and end his turn. Search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for the card titled ...Change Reality, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: A Beating You'll Never Forget
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your Backlash deck.

name: All the Things She Said...
Text: Shuffle 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, draw 1 card, put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand, remove 1 card in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game, and your opponent discards 1 card.

name: APA or A-Train?
Text: Can only be revealed if your Superstar card says you can reveal an Enforcer card. ≥ Hand Size: +12 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +Your maneuvers played from your hand are +1D. You cannot play non-unique Action cards from your hand. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +1 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'power,''bomb,'or 'slam'in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it in your hand and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards played with the word 'power,''bomb' or 'slam' in the title are -4F.

name: Arm Breaker
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your opponent must discard 1 card in order to play an Action card.

name: Asset Retrieval
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then search your Arsenal for 1 card that has the words 'packed by a Female Superstar'or 'packed by a Diva Superstar'in the text, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Atomic Lariat
Text: Can only be reversed by hybrid Reversal cards or unique Reversal cards.

name: Ax Kick
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to search his Arsenal for any number of cards and end his turn

name: Back to Basics
Text: You can only play Pre-match cards with the words 'old school'in the title. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Hell in a Cell Match. Search your Arsenal for 1 of each of the cards titled Arm Bar, Arm Bar Takedown, Arm Drag, Atomic Drop, Belly to Back Suplex, Belly to Belly Suplex, Body Slam, Chop, Clothesline, Collar and Elbow Lockup, Drop Kick, Haymaker, Head Butt, Hip Toss, Press Slam, Punch, Roundhouse Punch, Russian Leg Sweep, Snap Mare, Vertical Suplex, Wrist Lock, Backhand Slap, Drop Toe Hold, Elbow Drop, Foot Stomp, and Hammerlock, reveal them to your opponent, and put them under this card. You may play these cards as if they were in your hand. Your opponent searches your Arsenal and Backlash deck. If he finds any non-Superstar-specific Maneuver cards, you lose the game via Pinfall Victory. Shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Backstage Interview with Terri
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Trash Talkin' Interview is in your Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may draw up to 2 cards, then put any number of cards titled Trash Talkin' Interview and any number of cards with that card in the text from your Ringside pile into your Ring area, and then put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: Beatings from Dudleyville
Logos: Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley, Spike Dudley
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand when this is your first non-Pre-match card played of the game. When successfully played, discard 1 card.

name: Believe the Hype
Text: Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and your opponent discards 3 cards.

name: Benoit's German Suplex
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's Backlash deck and Arsenal when the card titled Series of Suplexes is in your Ring area.

name: Boot Lace
Text: Cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand. As a maneuver, can only be played if you reversed a card from your hand or Arsenal to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. As an action, discard this card and draw 1 card. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent.

name: Brock Block
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Series of Back Breakers, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Chest Lock Drop
Text: When played by a Diva Superstar, your opponent may discard 3 cards. If he does not, he cannot modify the Fortitude of his cards for the rest of the turn.

name: Chick Kick
Text: Unless your Superstar is Trish Stratus, can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. When successfully played, if your opponent is a Male Superstar, he overturns 4 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and your next Maneuver card played this turn is -6F. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 1 card, put this card into your hand, end your turn.

name: Chop Block
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D for every Heel card in your Ring area and can only be played after the card titled Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. As a reversal, reverse the cards titled Irish Whip, Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, or Over the Top Rope, or any maneuver played after those cards, and end your opponent's turn.

name: Dare to Take a Challenge
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may discard 1 card and then your opponent discards 2 cards. Then he may discard 1 card and you discard 2 cards. Repeat this until you or your opponent stops.

name: Distractingly Divalicious
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. Can only be played when your opponent is a Male Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, non-Reversal cards cannot be played during the first two turns of the match.

name: Divas Overload!
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Can be packed by every Diva Superstar, regardless of their Superstar Ability. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and if you have 3 or more cards in your Ring area with the words 'packed by a Female Superstar'or 'packed by a Diva Superstar'in the text.

name: Diving Bulldog
Text: Can only be played if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn.

name: Do You Want a Hug?
Text: Cannot be packed by the Two Man Power Trip. The card titled Hell in the Cell Match is blanked for the rest of the turn. When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating and you have fewer cards in your hand than him, he discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards he has in his hand greater than you. When played by The Rattlesnake, you may then draw up to 2 cards. When your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, he discards his hand. Choose # cards from his Ringside pile and put them into his hand, where # is equal to the number of cards discarded. When played by The Rattlesnake, he then discards 2 cards.

name: Does This Look Good on Me?
Text: As an action, look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards, and your opponent discards the chosen cards. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn

name: Don't Be Shy
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by a Diva Superstar. Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 Maneuver card with Fortitude equal to or less than his Fortitude Rating. During his next turn, the chosen card must be his first card played or he ends his turn.

name: Don't Cross the Boss
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, your cards titled No Chance in Hell! are -6F and put this card into your hand when you play the card titled No Chance in Hell! When this card is in your Ring area, your cards titled No Chance in Hell! are -6F and when your opponent successfully plays an Action card, you may draw 1 card. When the card titled Managed by Vince McMahon is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards your opponent may have in his Ring area is reduced by 2.

name: Double Clothesline Takedown
Text: As a reversal, when overturned, reverse the card titled Double Clothesline Takedown and end your opponent's turn, or when played from your hand, can only be played after the successfully played card titled Double Clothesline Takedown. That card does its normal damage, regardless of overturned Reversal cards. End your opponent's turn.

name: Drinking Beer - Raising Hell - Kicking Ass
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is 5 or greater, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, your opponent discards # cards, and your maneuvers are +#D for the rest of the turn, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: Drop Dead Gorgeous
Text: Cannot be reversed when your opponent is a Male Superstar. All players discard their hands.

name: Edge or Big Show?
Text: Can only be revealed if your Superstar card says you can reveal an Enforcer card. When this card is revealed, you cannot play cards that would increase your opponent's Superstar Value. ≥ Hand Size: +# Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +# is equal to twice your opponent's Superstar Value. You start the game after the Pre-match phase. ≥ Hand Size: +9 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +You must discard 2 cards in order to play a maneuver, unless it is your first maneuver played of the turn. You cannot play High Risk maneuvers. Your opponent's Grapple maneuvers played do no more than a maximum of 3D.

name: Elbow Smash
Text: When successfully played, put 1 Set-up card and 1 card with the word 'elbow'in the title from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: F-U
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card.

name: Falls Count Anywhere Match
Text: Any player wins via Pinfall victory if his Fortitude Rating is greater than his opponent's Fortitude Rating; and if he has 4 cards in his Ring area titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring, Over the Barricade, Into the Barricade, Over the Top Rope, Tossed Between the Ropes, or Top Rope Toss; and if his opponent has no cards in his hand.

name: For the Women that Want to Be Me...
Text: When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may overturn 3 cards and then put this card into your Ring area and you may choose 1 different Enforcer. When this card is in your Ring area, and your opponent is a Diva Superstar, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Forearm Uppercut
Text: When successfully played, overturn 1 card, you may draw 1 card, and your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Front Chancery
Text: When successfully played, your opponent may shuffle 1 card from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal.

name: Gail Kim and Molly Holly
Text: At the end of Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for the card titled Wake Up... or Molly-Go-Round, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. During each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, choose Strike or Grapple. Your High Risk maneuvers and maneuvers of the chosen type are -3F until you choose otherwise.

name: Gail's Hurricanrana
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Grapple maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Get a Look at These
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Can only be played when your opponent is a Male Superstar. Your opponent may discard the card titled Escape Move. If he does not, discard up to 2 cards and then he overturns # cards, where # is equal to the total Damage value of the discarded cards. End your turn.

name: Get the Tables!
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. Cannot be reversed when played by The Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, or D-Von Dudley. Search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards titled Table! Table! Table!, reveal them to your opponent, put 1 into your hand, put the rest into your Ringside pile, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1.

name: GGGGGGoooooolllllldddddd-berg!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, discard any number of cards. Put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile for every 2 cards discarded.

name: Girl on Girl Action!
Text: Can only be packed by a Female superstar. As an action, put 1 non-unique Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, if your opponent is a GM or Female Superstar, reverse any non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Girly Punch
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Can only be reversed by reversals of printed D: 0. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play this card.

name: Goldberg
Text: You cannot pack non-hybrid Reversal cards. You may discard 3 cards to reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card with the word 'spear' or 'jackhammer' in the title, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your cards titled Spear and Jackhammer are F:0 and +3D.

name: Goldberg's Jackhammer
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver with the word 'spear'in the title or if you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn.

name: Goldberg's Spear
Text: As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Gory Special
Text: As a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for the card titled Eddie's Roll Up, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If it is your next card played this turn, it cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! As a reversal, reverse any Strike maneuver of 7D or greater and end your opponent's turn.

name: Gregory Helms, Ace Reporter
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is +#, where # is equal to your Superstar Value.

name: Gut Buster On Top Rope
Text: Cannot be reversed when the card titled Gut Buster is in your Ring area. When played after the card titled Gut Wrench, your opponent's Reversal cards to this card are an additional +10F.

name: Highlight Reel
Text: This card can be played during any of your Pre-match phases. Your opponent may overturn 15 cards. If he does not, the maximum number of Pre-match cards he may have in his Ring area is reduced by 2.

name: Houston Hangover
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D or greater maneuver. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Hurricane Clothesline
Text: This card is -4F when played by The Hurricane. Reversals to this card are +3D. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver with the word 'clothesline'in the title and end your opponent's turn.

name: I Know How to Use Them
Text: You may choose 1 different Enforcer. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put 1 card from your opponent's Ring area into his Ringside pile.

name: I'll Take a Shot
Text: Draw 1 card and reveal it. If it is an Action or Maneuver card and it is not your next card played this turn, discard it and end your turn. If it is your next card played this turn, if your opponent reverses it, he skips his next turn.

name: I'm Always on Top...
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your Maneuver cards are -3F. At the end of your turn, when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, put this card into your Ringside pile.

name: I'm Gonna Break You
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, if your opponent has more cards in his Ring area than you have in your Ring area, look at his hand and choose # cards, where # is equal to the number of Pre-match cards he has in his Ring area and Ringside pile greater than you have in your Ring area and Ringside pile, and choose one: he discards the chosen cards or shuffles them into his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, when you have to remove any number of cards from the game, you may remove this card from the game instead of 1 of the cards.

name: I'm Gonna Teach You a Lesson in Thuganomics
Text: Reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards he has in his hand greater than you have in your hand.

name: I'm Just a Sexy Boy
Text: As an action, can only be played as the first card of your turn and cannot be reversed when your opponent is a Female Superstar. Draw up to 6 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: I'm Trying Not to Lose My Temper
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has more Pre-match cards in his Ring area than you have in your Ring area. Cannot be reversed when your opponent is Los Guerreros. Choose 1 Manager or Event card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, that card is blanked. When your opponent is Ric Flair, this card is Permanent.

name: I've Got a Leg Up On You
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by a Diva Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, you may overturn 1 card and then he overturns 2 cards.

name: I've Got a Nice ... Bottom
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, cards are overturned onto this card instead of put into your Ringside pile. During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and put up to 10 cards on top of this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and put the rest into your Ringside pile. If this card is removed from your Ring area, put all cards on top of this card into your Ringside pile.

name: I've Had More Championships than You've Had Women
Text: Cannot be packed by a GM Superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, your Title Belt cards have the added text of 'The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1.'

name: If You're Not Cheating, You're Not Trying
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Los Guerreros. Remove 1 card in your Ringside pile from the game and then either put 1 of your cards that has been removed from the game into your Ringside pile or put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: It Doesn't Stop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Discard 1 card. If your next card played this turn is a maneuver of 8D or less, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text and it cannot be reversed.

name: It's Over
Text: Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed.

name: It's Time I Made Some Changes
Text: Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal and then draw the same number of cards.

name: Jab
Text: When successfully played, your opponent randomly discards 1 card from his Backlash deck.

name: Jamie Noble Interferes
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn. You may put 1 Action card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: John Cena
Text: Your cards titled Taunt the Fans and Steel Chain Shot are not Heel cards. When you successfully play a maneuver from your hand, you may discard 1 card and then your opponent randomly discards 3 cards from his Backlash deck. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your cards with the word 'chain' in the title.

name: Lady's Grapevine
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva superstar. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played Submission maneuver. As a reversal, reverse the cards titled Backslide, Roll Up, Inside Cradle, or Victory Roll and end your opponent's turn. When successfully played, you and your opponent cannot play any cards that do not reverse this maneuver until it is reversed. Once during each of your turns, this maneuver does its damage, even if played as a reversal, until it is reversed.

name: Let's Wrestle Already!
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, when overturned by a non-damage card effect, even during the Pre-match phase, reverse the effect, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, and end your opponent's turn.

name: Lousy Foot Work
Text: Your opponent may discard the card titled Escape Move or Step Aside. If he does not, during his next turn, he cannot play Maneuver cards.

name: Managed by Jamie Noble
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and then put up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your hand

name: Managed by Miss Jackie
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile, put 1 non-unique non-Superstar-specific Pre-match card from your Ringside pile into your Ring area, and then end your turn.

name: Managed by Stevie Richards
Text: The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1. When this card is in your Ring area, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 4 cards and then put this card into your Ring area. When the card titled Stevie Interferes is in your Ring area, discard 1 card instead.

name: Managed by Theodore Long
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, if you have fewer cards in your hand than your opponent, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile, draw 5 cards, and then discard 2 cards.

name: Modified Bow and Arrow
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Submission maneuver or if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! or Strangle Hold. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for the card titled Maintain Hold, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Modified Clutch Onto Opponent
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Can only be reversed by cards that specifically reverse the card titled Clutch onto Opponent. When successfully played, draw 1 card or look at your opponent's hand. You cannot play the card titled Maintain Hold or Apply Illegal Leverage immediately after this card.

name: Molly-Go-Round
Text: You may search for and play this card as if it were a High Risk maneuver. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When successfully played, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand than your opponent, you win the game via Pinfall victory. As an action, this card is -25F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent.

name: Mr. Monday Night
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if this is the first card played of your turn and you reversed a card from your hand or Backlash deck to end your opponent's last turn. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: My New Gimmick
Text: Draw 1 card. Name 1 non-unique non-Superstar-specific Maneuver card. All cards with that title are Permanent.

name: Nidia
Text: You cannot pack maneuvers of 4D or greater. You can pack the card titled Tough Enough! Your cards titled Trailer Park Trash and Kissing Up to the Stinkin' Fans are not Heel cards. Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 Action card and then shuffle up to 2 non-hybrid cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Nidia, Hook Up the Double Wide
Text: Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal, where # is equal to double the cards you have in your hand. # cannot be greater than 10.

name: No Matching Tights
Text: As an action, reveal 1 card in your hand with the same title as a card in your Ring area. Discard it and draw up to 2 cards. As a reversal, when played from your hand, reverse any card and end your opponent's turn. If your opponent does not have 1 card in his Ring area with the same title as the reversed card, you must reveal 1 card in your hand with the same title as the reversed card.

name: Not Today, Cupcake!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent has the card titled Bra and Panties Match or a Female Manager card in his Ring area. Choose 1 Event card in your opponent's Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, that card is blanked.

name: Old School Psychology
Text: When Back to Basics is not in your Ring, this card is Active. When this card is in your Ring, your opponent cannot play Old School Wrestling Match, and when they play a Backlash card, they discard 1 card.

name: Once You Go Test, You Forget the Rest
Text: You may put this card into your Ring area before the Pre-match. When this card is in your Ring area, the maximum number of Pre-match and Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 1, and if your opponent is a Female Superstar, you may put this card into your Ringside pile to reverse any card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Overshot Your Mark
Text: Reverse any Strike maneuver of 5D or greater, any High Risk maneuver, or any maneuver played after the card titled Irish Whip, and end your opponent's turn. This card is +#D, where # is equal to the reversed maneuver's Damage.

name: Panic Assault
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Can only be played with a printed F:0 Grapple maneuver of printed 3D or less from your hand. He cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play these cards. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring area. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: Panic Grab
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Can only be played with a printed F:0 Submission maneuver of printed 4D or less from your hand. He cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play these cards. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring area. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: Panic Throw
Text: Can only be played when your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating. Can only be played with a printed F:0 Strike maneuver of printed 3D or less from your hand. He cannot play the card titled Over Sell Maneuver immediately after you play these cards. Unless both maneuvers are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played and both go into your Ring area. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: Perennial Fan Favorites
Text: Can only be packed if your Superstar card says you cannot play any title belt except the Tag Team Title Belts or if this is a Tag Team format match. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile and shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and put 1 Face card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: Pump Me Up
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Draw up to 2 cards.

name: Puppy Love
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Put any number of cards titled Puppies! Puppies! from your hand under this card, and then search your Arsenal for any number of those cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may remove this card from the game or put 1 card from under this card into your Ringside pile and your next card played this turn is -10F. If this card is removed from your Ring area, put all cards under it into your Ringside pile.

name: Puppy Power!
Text: Shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then draw 1 card, or discard 1 card and then your opponent overturns 2 cards. End your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: Reach for the Ropes
Text: Reverse any Submission maneuver (including the card titled Clutch Onto Opponent) and end your opponent's turn. You may draw 1 card.

name: Recover Again
Text: This card is -2F when the card titled Recovery is in your Ring area. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. Discard 1 card unless the card titled Recovery is in your Ring area.

name: Reverse 180-Degree Chair Shot
Text: Can only be played if there is a card in any Ring area with the word 'chair' in the title and if this is the first card played of your turn.

name: Reverse Fall-away Slam
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand or randomly remove 1 card in your opponent's hand from the game.

name: Rey Rey's Flying Body Press
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after the card titled From the Top Rope. As an action, this card is -2F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent.

name: Rikishi's Superkick
Text: When successfully played, you may draw 1 card or shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Rules Were Meant to be Broken
Text: Your Starting Hand Size is -1. When this card is in your Ring area, you may discard 1 Maneuver card and 1 Action card to reverse any Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Run the Gauntlet
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Backstage Ambush Attempt is in your Ring area. Your opponent cuts his Arsenal to reveal a card and then overturns cards equal to the revealed card's Damage. Your opponent shuffles his Arsenal and repeats the above # more times, where # is equal to the number of your revealed Enforcer cards.

name: Running Spinebuster
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is less than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, this card is -5F.

name: RVD or Booker T?
Text: Can only be revealed if your Superstar card says you can reveal an Enforcer card. When this card is revealed, the Maximum number of Mid-match cards you may have in your Ring area is increased by 2. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +Once during your turn, you may discard 1 Strike or High Risk Maneuver card and if your next card played this turn is a Strike or High Risk Maneuver, it is -#F, where # is equal to the discarded maneuver's Fortitude. ≥ Hand Size: +8 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +Before your Draw Segment, if your Fortitude Rating is greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside pile at the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Sable
Text: Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. Your Arsenal may only contain 50 cards. Twice during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards and then remove the top card of your opponent's Arsenal from the game. Your opponent cannot play any card with the word 'Sable' in the title.

name: Sable Bomb
Text: As a maneuver, when your opponent is a Male Superstar, he may remove 3 cards in his hand from the game to reverse this card and end your turn. As a reversal, reverse the card titled Back Body Drop and end your opponent's turn.

name: Sable-licious
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns, when you overturn any number of cards, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 of the overturned cards into your hand.

name: Series of Kicks
Text: Can only be played after a card with the word 'kick'in the title. Can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal. If this card is not reversed from your opponent's Arsenal, you may discard 2 cards and then apply the damage and effects of this card and it can be reversed as usual. This can be repeated.

name: Shake My Hand, Boy!
Text: Your opponent may draw 1 card and then discard 3 cards. If he does not, if your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it cannot be reversed from his hand.

name: Show and Go
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Can only be played after a successfully played Action card. If an effect your opponent controls removes this card from your Ring area, if you are a Diva Superstar, you may draw 1 card.

name: Showdown!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played Action card. End your opponent's turn. Your opponent's Reversal cards to the first card played on your next turn are +8F.

name: Side Effect
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When successfully played, you may put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand and 1 Backlash deck card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck.

name: Skirt the Issue
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva. Cannot be packed when packing BASH D: 1+ cards.

name: Skirt vs. Skirt Match
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Can only be played when your opponent is Female Superstar. Your opponent cannot play the card titled Women's Title Belt. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may discard 1 Action card and then look at his hand, choose up to 3 Maneuver cards, and he discards the chosen cards.

name: So Solly! So Sorey!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or if you reversed a card from your hand to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. Remove up to 3 cards in your opponent's Ringside pile from the game and then he may shuffle 1 card from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal.

name: Some Gals Don't Get Any Action
Text: Can only be packed by a Female superstar. As an action, put 1 non-unique Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand. As a reversal, if your opponent is a Male Superstar, reverse any non-Set-up non-unique Action card and end your opponent's turn.

name: Spinning Clothesline
Text: Reversals to this card are +2D.

name: Stacy Keibler
Text: You may pack Enforcers in your Backstage area. Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. Your Arsenal may only contain 50 cards. Your cards titled Diversion are Set-up cards and -9F. Ignore the 'The maximum number of Pre-match cards you may have in your Ring area is reduced by 1' text on your card titled Managed by Stacy Keibler. Your opponent cannot play any card with the word 'Keibler' in the title.

name: Steiner Flatliner
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver.

name: Stevie Interferes
Text: Reverse any non-unique card and end your opponent's turn. When the card titled Managed by Stevie Richards is not in your Ring area, discard 1 card.

name: Straddle the Ropes
Text: During your opponent's first turn of the game, when he plays an Action card, he discards 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring area, during your turn you may put this card into your Ringside pile, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and your opponent removes the chosen card from the game.

name: Strike a Pose
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher card and end your opponent's turn. If the first card played on your next turn is an Action card, it cannot be reversed.

name: Suicide Dive
Text: This card is -2F when you have a card in your Ring area with the Raw logo. Can only be played after a successfully played card. When successfully played, overturn 1 card.

name: Sump'tin' Be Started
Text: This card is -9F when the card titled I Aims ta be Startin' Sump'tin' is in your Ring area. Your opponent randomly discards 2 cards from his Backlash deck. When this card is in your Ring area, if an effect your opponent controls removes any number of your cards from the game or removes any number of your cards from your Ring area or forces you to discard any number of cards from your Backlash deck, you may instead remove this card from the game.

name: Superior Leg Work
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a maneuver, draw 1 card or your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Tap! Tap! Tap, You Sonofa-!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played non-Restricted-Modification-Symbol Submission maneuver. Cannot be played after any card that says you cannot play the card titled Maintain Hold immediately after this card. Cannot be reversed when the card titled First to Tap Out Match is in your Ring area. If your next card played this turn is the card titled Maintain Hold, you can ignore the 'Can only be played after...'text and the maneuver being maintained is considered a Submission / Submission Multi and its text is blanked.

name: Teaser Mode
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Face card, reveal it to your opponent, put it in your hand, shuffle your Arsenal, and end your turn. When this card is in your Ring area, your Face Action cards are -#F, where # is equal to the number of Face cards in your Ring area. This effect is not cumulative with other cards titled Teaser Mode.

name: Test or Freakzilla?
Text: Can only be packed by Superstars that can pack Enforcers. ≥ Hand Size: +2 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: +Before your Draw Segment, your opponent discards # cards (# = number of their Hand cards greater than the total of 2 + number of your Hand cards, max 2). ≥ Hand Size: +8 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and your next maneuver played this turn is -8F. You cannot play 3+ maneuvers per turn.

name: That One Thing
Text: When played, choose Strike, Grapple, or Submission. This card is considered that type until it leaves your Ring area. When this card is in your Ringside pile, if you do not have more Reversal cards in your Ring area than your opponent, during your turn you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: That's Gonna Leave a Mark!
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. Put up to 2 Grapple maneuvers from your Ringside pile into your hand and put 1 non-Maneuver card with the word 'mark'in the title from your Ringside pile into your Ring area. If your next card played this turn is a Grapple maneuver of 4D or less, it is +5D.

name: The Boise Beauty
Text: Draw up to 2 cards and then shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: The Flair Flop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver of 4D or greater. Blank that maneuver's text until the end of the turn, overturn cards until the maneuver is reversed or until full damage has been applied, and end your opponent's turn. You may put any number of cards titled Over Sell Maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: The Goddess Returns
Text: As an action, this card is -6F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: The Hubbub Backstage
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Backstage Politics is in your opponent's Ring area. Cannot be reversed. Your opponent randomly discards # cards from his Backlash deck, where # is equal to the number of Enforcer cards he has revealed. # cannot be less than 2.

name: The Name of the Game Is Wrestling
Text: Can only be played when you have fewer Action cards in your Ring area than your opponent. When this card is in your Ring area, when your opponent successfully plays a non-Set-up Action card, you may remove this card from the game and end his turn.

name: The Peep's Champ
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, your Superstar Value is +3 and your opponent's Superstar Value is -3. When your Fortitude Rating and Superstar Value are greater than your opponent's Fortitude Rating and Superstar Value, your opponent cannot play Superstar-specific cards.

name: The Special Kiss
Text: When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, your opponent overturns 2 cards. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may discard 3 cards and then put this card into your hand.

name: The World's Greatest Suplex
Text: When successfully played, you may put 1 Maneuver card from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: This Diva's Got Claws!
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva superstar. When this card is in your Ring area, your Strike maneuvers are +1D and if you play a non-Strike maneuver, put this card into your Ringside pile. When this card is in your Ringside pile, during your turn you may remove this card from the game and put 1 Strike maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: This Is Going Nowhere Fast
Text: Can only be played when you have 2 or more non-hybrid Reversal cards in your hand. Reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. Discard 2 non-hybrid Reversal cards.

name: Too Many Rules and Too Many Refs
Text: As an action, you may discard this card and draw 1 card. Doing this will cause no damage to your opponent. As a reversal, reverse any card with the Restricted Modification Symbol and end your opponent's turn. After damage from this card has been applied, your opponent shuffles up to 3 cards from his Ringside pile into his Arsenal.

name: Took That on the Chin
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 8D or greater maneuver. If that maneuver is reversed from your Arsenal, put this card into your Backlash deck. If it is not reversed from your Arsenal, you may discard 1 Mid-match card. If you do, end your opponent's turn.

name: Top Rope Toss
Text: When successfully played, put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal and then search your Arsenal for the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring or 1 card with the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring in the text, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. Your next card played this turn is considered played after the card titled Throw Opponent Out of the Ring. If the card titled Lumberjack Match is in any Ring area, your opponent also discards 2 cards or overturns 5 cards.

name: Torrie Wilson
Text: You cannot pack maneuvers of 4D or greater unless they have the word 'DDT' in the title. Once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique Action card, reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. He cannot play any card with the word 'Torrie' in the title.

name: Torrie's DDT
Text: This card is -2F when your opponent is a Female Superstar. When successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Tough Enough Head Trainer
Text: Can only be played when the card titled Tough Enough! is in any Ring area. When this card is in your Ring area, once during each of your turns you may discard 2 cards, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Trailer Park Slap
Text: When this card is in your Ring area or Ringside pile, during your turn you may remove 1 card in your hand from the game and then put this card into your hand.

name: Twisted Smile
Text: Your opponent may discard 4 cards. If he does not, draw up to 3 cards.

name: Unmasked Vengeance
Text: Your opponent reveals the top 10 cards of his Arsenal, randomly discards 5 of them, and puts the rest into his hand. Reveal the top 3 cards of your Arsenal, put 1 into your hand, and the rest into your Ringside pile. If that card is your next card played this turn, it is F:0.

name: Unorthodox Wrist Lock
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed by the card titled Backlash! When successfully played, you may put 1 High Risk maneuver from your Ringside pile into your hand and then put 1 card from your hand on top of your Arsenal.

name: Unstoppable
Text: As a reversal, reverse any non-unique maneuver and end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring area, when you successfully play a Foreign Object card, you may shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside pile into your Arsenal.

name: Victoria
Text: Once during each of your turns you may shuffle your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards. Your cards titled Battling the Voices are -6F and cannot be reversed.

name: Victory Roll
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D or greater maneuver. Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Wake Up...
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent played a maneuver during his last turn. Your opponent discards 3 cards. Search your Arsenal and Ringside pile for the card titled ...Look Around..., reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: What Are You Gawking At?
Text: Can only be packed by a Diva Superstar. Can only be played when your opponent is a Male Superstar. Your opponent may discard the card titled Break the Hold. If he does not, he discards # cards, where # is equal to the number of cards he has in his hand greater than you have in your hand.

name: Wheelbarrow Slam
Text: Can only be reversed from your opponent's hand. When successfully played, overturn 1 card.

name: Where's the Payoff?
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. Your opponent may discard the card titled Escape Move or Step Aside. If he does not, discard any number of cards and he discards the same number of cards.

name: Who's Next?
Text: Draw 1 card. Your next maneuver played this turn can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal.

name: Widow's Peak
Text: Can only be played when you reversed a card to end your opponent's last turn and this is the first card played of your turn. When this card is in your Ringside pile, once during each of your turns you may remove your Backlash deck from the game and then put this card into your hand.

name: Word Life
Text: Your opponent may discard 3 Reversal cards. If he does not, he discards 5 cards.

name: Wrestling with a Broken Freakin' Neck
Text: Can only be played after a Set-up card. When this card is in your Ring area, your Grapple maneuvers and your opponent's cards with the word 'neck'in the title are +2D.

name: WWE Centerfold of the Year
Text: When your opponent is a Male Superstar, he plays with his hand revealed. When he is a Female Superstar, once during each of your turns, before your Draw Segment, he overturns 1 card.

name: Yes, I've Lost My Mind
Text: As an action, reveal your hand to your opponent and discard all non-Maneuver cards. Your maneuvers can only be reversed from your opponent's Arsenal for the rest of the turn. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-Trademark-Finisher maneuver and end your opponent's turn.

name: Yo! Kill da Beat!
Text: If your Superstar Value is less than your opponent's Superstar Value, you and your opponent can only play Pre-match cards with the word 'taunt'in the title. If your Superstar Value is greater than your opponent's Superstar Value, after your opponent plays his next Pre-match card, you and your opponent can only play Pre-match cards with the word 'taunt'in the title.

name: You Can't See Me
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. You may draw 1 card. If you do not, if your opponent reverses your next maneuver played this turn from his hand or Backlash deck, he skips his next turn.

name: You Fight Like a Woman
Text: Reverse any card that would force you to overturn any number of cards or, when overturned by a non-damage card effect, even during the Pre-match phase, reverse the effect or, when your opponent is a Female Superstar, reverse any non-unique maneuver. End your opponent's turn. When your opponent is a non-Diva Superstar, you may look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the card chosen.

name: You Should Cover Your Eyes
Text: Can only be packed by a Male Superstar. When your opponent is a Female Superstar, his Starting Hand Size is -3.

name: You Will Never Forget the Name of...
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 2 Maneuver cards, reveal them to your opponent, put them into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: You're Gonna Pay!
Text: Discard up to # cards from your Backlash deck, where # is equal to your Superstar Value. Your opponent discards the same number of cards from his Backlash deck.
